mentions.name: Little Green Viper iOS/Watch/Mac apps
mentions.description: A collection of personal iOS, Apple Watch, and Mac apps that the author is transitioning to Apple's "Liquid Glass" design language. One of the apps was built in collaboration with a professional graphic designer.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I should be able to do it with my various personal apps, but one app I've written, was done in concert with a professional graphic designer, and he is not happy with LG, so I expect that app to be a pain.

These are my apps: https://littlegreenviper.com/AppDocs/
